acip: MTSAMS MED PA LNGA LA SOGS PA LAS KYI SGRIB PA THAMS CAD KYANG YONGS SU BYANG BAR 'GYUR, NAD THAMS CAD KYIS MI BTAB PAR 'GYUR, RING DU 'TSO BAR 'GYUR, DUS MA YIN PAR 'CHI BA'I 'JIGS PA THAMS CAD LAS YONGS SU THAR PAR 'GYUR,
wylie: mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa las kyi sgrib pa thams cad kyang yongs su byang bar 'gyur, nad thams cad kyis mi btab par 'gyur, ring du 'tsho bar 'gyur, dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad las yongs su thar par 'gyur
english: All of their karmic obstacles—even so far as actions like the five “immediate” misdeeds—are completely cleaned away.  No illness can ever touch them; and they live a very long life.  They are freed, entirely, from any fear of suffering an untimely death.
